cohort: 20 renal transplant recipients who gave birth between January 2010 and December 2019
finding: Despite the presence of preterm delivery and comorbidities like hypertension and preeclampsia, renal transplant recipients experienced good perinatal outcomes with appropriate antenatal/peripartum follow-up and analgesia/anesthesia management.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were performed in the majority of deliveries (11/14; 78.6%), primarily under spinal block, while general anesthesia was used in three women (21.4%).
